outputs: Generated code and commands for setting up experiments, executing training scripts, and reporting metrics
Agents generate code and commands to set up and execute experiments in research repositories.

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate 'SUPER' dataset entry and consolidated output description. The paper focuses on code generation for repository setup and execution.
Normalized metric names to standard capitalization and removed duplicates
Removed placeholder 'None' values and confirmed no LLM-as-judge evaluation is used

guideline: Workers were instructed to execute solutions on Google Colab, submit solution notebooks, answers, git commit hashes, and dependency lists, and report any unspecified decisions made during execution.

changes_made.explanation: Removed incorrect human evaluation metadata. The human experts were used to create gold solutions for the benchmark, not to evaluate LLM-generated outputs. No human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted.

overall_notes: This paper primarily addresses code generation for setting up and executing research repository tasks, not natural language generation. The human experts mentioned were used to create benchmark solutions, not to evaluate LLM outputs. The paper uses automatic metrics (Accuracy, Landmark-based evaluation, Script-Executed) to evaluate generated code and commands.
